decision_framework.primary_media_metric_definition: Shopify revenue ÷ paid spend. This is the paid media decision metric.
decision_framework.business_reporting_metric_definition: (Shopify + Amazon) ÷ paid spend. Useful for broader business reporting; not for media-buying decisions.
decision_framework.context: B2G2 Memorial Day sale. A true 2.0x Shopify MER is a healthy result if order volume is strong and Amazon is incremental on top.

scaling.signal: Shopify MER 2.1x+ with stable or growing order volume
scaling.response: Clear scale-up zone. Increase total daily budget 10%–20% next day.
Scale-up territory for Meta. Increase Meta budgets 10%–15%.

scaling.signal: Google ROAS 4.0x+ with room to spend
scaling.response: Increase Google budgets or loosen caps.
Lean into spend — offer is converting without trashing basket size.
Hold/watch zone. Decision depends on AOV, CVR, and contribution margin. If margin is healthy, lean toward holding budgets; rotate creative and monitor.

scaling.signal: Meta ROAS 1.5x–1.8x and blended MER is healthy
scaling.response: Hold/optimize. Don't pull Meta back if blended Shopify MER is in the healthy zone. Shift incremental dollars where they perform.
Hold if contribution margin still works. Volume can carry a softer AOV.

scaling.signal: Shopify MER below 1.7x for a full day
scaling.response: Pullback zone. Cut next-day planned increase by 15%–25% and re-evaluate.

scaling.signal: Meta ROAS below 1.4x–1.5x with rising CPA
scaling.response: Pull Meta back or pause weakest ad sets/creatives.
Funnel / offer-clarity warning. Check offer comprehension, landing page, cart, and discount application — not necessarily a budget cut.
Margin check. Re-confirm contribution margin and whether 5 for $99 is cannibalizing the B2G2 path.

risks.why: Customers may not add 4 bands and may not see discount
risks.mitigation: Message: Add 4 bands to cart. Pay for 2. Use cart reminder.

risks.why: Customers may not know which offer is better
risks.mitigation: Make B2G2 dominant; keep 5 for $99 secondary.

risks.why: Revenue ROAS can look good while profit tightens
risks.mitigation: Monitor contribution margin, AOV, units/order, discount rate.

risks.why: Best sellers can sell through from Shopify + Amazon demand
risks.mitigation: Daily inventory check; redirect traffic if hero SKUs run low.

risks.why: Total MER may look better than Shopify media performance
risks.mitigation: Use Shopify MER for media decisions; treat Amazon as incremental business reporting only.

risks.why: All-products path may reduce cart completion
risks.mitigation: Prefer dedicated Memorial Day sale collection / best sellers page.
